note: TransformerPath Global Transformer Standards & Regulations Directory. Comprehensive register of international and national transformer engineering standards, test codes, efficiency mandates (e.g. EU Ecodesign, US DOE 2027), and grid interconnection codes by country and category. Every entry carries verification_status and verification_date reflecting direct website verification.

standards.title: Power Transformers — Part 1: General
standards.scope: Applies to three-phase and single-phase power transformers (including autotransformers) with the exception of certain small and special transformers. Defines rating conventions, tapping ranges, connection symbols, rating plates, tolerances, and routine/type/special tests.
standards.efficiency_requirements: Refers to national grid codes and regional efficiency regulations (e.g., EN 50588-1 for EU Ecodesign Tier 2)

standards.title: Power Transformers — Part 2: Temperature rise for liquid-immersed transformers
standards.scope: Specifies temperature-rise limits for mineral-oil and alternative liquid-immersed transformers (winding average, top oil, hot-spot). Defines cooling methods (ONAN, ONAF, OFAF, ODAF, OFWF, ODWF) and test procedures.
standards.efficiency_requirements: Thermal limits directly govern load losses and life expectancy

standards.title: Power Transformers — Part 3: Insulation levels, dielectric tests and external clearances in air
standards.scope: Specifies the insulation requirements and dielectric test procedures for transformers. Defines test levels for lightning impulse (LI), switching impulse (SI), applied voltage (AV), and induced voltage with partial discharge measurement (IVPD).

standards.title: Power Transformers — Part 5: Ability to withstand short circuit
standards.scope: Defines the requirements for a power transformer to sustain the thermal and mechanical effects of external short circuits without damage. Specifies calculation methods for thermal withstand and physical laboratory test conditions for dynamic short-circuit verification.
standards.efficiency_requirements: Mandatory short-circuit qualification required by utilities

standards.title: Standard for General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers
standards.scope: The foundation standard for all liquid-immersed transformers across North America. Defines electrical, mechanical, and safety capabilities, ratings, tap designations, basic lightning impulse levels (BIL), and service conditions.
standards.efficiency_requirements: Coordinates with US Department of Energy (DOE) 10 CFR Part 431 efficiency rules

standards.title: Standard Test Code for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers
standards.scope: Comprehensive test methods for resistance measurements, polarity, phase relation, ratio, no-load loss and excitation current, load loss and impedance voltage, dielectric tests, temperature rise, short-circuit tests, and audible sound levels.
standards.efficiency_requirements: Prescribes certified test method for verifying DOE energy efficiency compliance

standards.title: Energy Conservation Standards for Distribution Transformers
standards.scope: Federal efficiency regulation mandating strict minimum efficiency standards for liquid-immersed and dry-type distribution transformers manufactured in or imported into the United States. Establishes significant adoption of amorphous core alloy and high-grade grain-oriented electrical steel (GOES).
standards.voltage_levels_kv: Single-phase and three-phase MV distribution up to 34.5 kV
standards.efficiency_requirements: Increases efficiency standards significantly; requires compliance using certified IEEE C57.12.90 loss testing

standards.title: Ecodesign Requirements for Small, Medium and Large Power Transformers (Tier 2)
standards.scope: Legally binding efficiency mandate across all 27 EU member states, EEA, and UK (BS EN 50588-1). Sets maximum allowable load losses (Pk) and no-load losses (Po) for medium power transformers and minimum Peak Efficiency Index (PEI) for large power transformers.
standards.voltage_levels_kv: 1 kV to >36 kV up to 800 kV
standards.efficiency_requirements: Mandatory Tier 2 maximum loss tables (Po and Pk) and Peak Efficiency Index (PEI)
standards.compliance_deadline: Tier 2 in mandatory effect since July 1, 2021

standards.title: Outdoor Type Oil Immersed Distribution Transformers up to and including 2500 kVA, 33 kV
standards.scope: Mandatory national standard governing all distribution transformers up to 2.5 MVA in India. Governed under the BIS Quality Control Order (QCO), with mandatory Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) Star Labeling (Level 1 to Level 5).
standards.efficiency_requirements: Mandatory BEE Star Rating loss caps; BIS ISI certification strictly mandatory for manufacture and sale
standards.compliance_deadline: Mandatory Quality Control Order in active force

standards.title: Power Transformers — General, Temperature Rise, Insulation Levels, Short-Circuit
standards.scope: India's national power transformer series, harmonized with IEC 60076 with CEA (Central Electricity Authority) grid manual amendments for tropical operating environments (50°C reference ambient) and 400 kV / 765 kV substations.
standards.efficiency_requirements: CEA Technical Standards for Construction of Electrical Plants and Electric Lines

standards.title: Power Transformers (National Standard of the People's Republic of China)
standards.scope: Primary national standard governing transformers across the State Grid Corporation of China (SGCC) and China Southern Power Grid (CSG). Covers AC power transformers from distribution through 1,000 kV UHV AC and converter transformers up to ±1,100 kV DC.
standards.efficiency_requirements: GB 20052 (Minimum Allowable Values of Energy Efficiency and Energy Efficiency Grades for Power Transformers)
standards.compliance_deadline: Mandatory GB 20052-2020 energy efficiency grades in effect

standards.standard_body: DIN / DKE (German Commission for Electrical, Electronic & Information Technologies)
standards.title: Leistungstransformatoren (German National Adoption of European Standard EN 60076)
standards.scope: Governs the manufacture and installation of transformers in Germany. Incorporates national VDE safety specifications, DIN 42500 component mounting interfaces (DIN bushings and valves), and VDMA mechanical guidelines.

standards.standard_body: Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization (SASO)
standards.title: Electrical Power Transformers & Energy Performance Requirements for Distribution Transformers
standards.scope: Mandates energy performance, maximum loss values, and extreme ambient temperature withstand (up to 55°C ambient, desert dust ingress protection) for all transformers installed in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and connected to National Grid SA.
standards.efficiency_requirements: Mandatory SASO Energy Efficiency Certificate through SABER platform

standards.title: Transformadores de potência (Power Transformers Requirements and Tests)
standards.scope: The governing national standard for transformers across Brazil's National Interconnected System (SIN). Regulates distribution, generation step-up, and 500 kV/230 kV transmission transformers under ONS (Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico) grid procedures.
standards.efficiency_requirements: Governed by INMETRO Energy Conservation Labelling Program (PBE)
